rationale: I will take up 30 mmol/gDW/h of D-glucose, 5 mmol/gDW/h of L-arginine, and 5 mmol/gDW/h of Ammonium (nh4) to meet the growth costs. I will also take up 10 mmol/gDW/h of L-lactate and 10 mmol/gDW/h of D-lactate to provide a carbon source. I will release 10 mmol/gDW/h of lactate, 10 mmol/gDW/h of acetate, and 0.11 mmol/gDW/h of formate as fermentation products.
